A Slower Weekend in Zurich

A flexible first weekend in Zurich, built around Grossmünster and Kunsthaus Zürich.

By Travelber Editorial · Updated 19 October 2026

IN THIS GUIDE

Arrival: keep the evening easyDay one: GrossmünsterDay two: Kunsthaus ZürichWeather and getting aroundOfficial sources
← Switzerland overview

Arrival: keep the evening easy

Check in, settle your luggage and take a short walk near your base. Save the main sightseeing for a full day. Compare where to stay in Zurich before booking.

Day one: Grossmünster

Give Grossmünster the main block of your day. Check the official visitor information for ticketing and access, then leave the afternoon open for nearby streets, food and a slower walk.

Day two: Kunsthaus Zürich

Build the next day around Kunsthaus Zürich. Verify the journey from your accommodation and leave time to collect luggage before departure. If your return is early, choose one short visit instead of trying to finish a checklist.

Weather and getting around

Scenic transport services have route-specific operating calendars; check boat and mountain connections for your exact travel date.

Use SBB for connected rail, bus and boat journeys, and check panoramic trains separately for service-specific seat reservations.
